title: Browser performance profiling
description: Practice browser performance profiling through a self-contained HTML browser interaction, a failing starter, a corrected solution and repeatable regression checks.
objectives: Explain browser performance profiling in real browser state and semantics
Repair the broken DOM interaction without unsafe HTML insertion
Verify the interaction via local Node assertions and Chromium behavioral checks

sources.label: Official browser API or accessibility reference

rubric: I can reproduce the original browser performance profiling failure.
I can explain the DOM state and keyboard semantics of the repair.
I validate the page in a real browser, not only through source-text checks.
